facts.value: Sequence-level distillation is the only vocabulary-agnostic route: with a 7.57x vocab ratio there is no token-level probability alignment, so logits KL is not a tuning problem, it is undefined. Cross-vocab logits distillation by aligned character spans is research, not engineering. Rebuilding our vocab to the teacher's invalidates every checkpoint and is a user-owned decision under the 2026-08-29 freeze (docs/lessons/scale_36b_plan.md#词表解冻条件-2).
